decision_title: Admit only current nonerased AI garrison recovery and sale actors while retaining recovery, repair and production capability
decision_text:
Fix the demonstrated R203 AI admission defect at its command candidate boundary. Use current owned BuildingSnaps plus SpecialState.erasures to derive View.erased_buildings; this is transient knowledge, not additional simulation or controller state. Keep all ownership/capability/recovery/cargo lists intact. In last_stand, after ordinary force viability and the existing patience guard, retain recovery before liquidation for both fresh and existing last-stand entry; choose the first currently nonerased host, otherwise wait. Filter all three sale candidate enumerations before value/ranking/refund projection. Keep public validators unchanged and preserve RepairBuilding/Rally/Queue/Cancel/Place/Interact target semantics exactly; their legal passive/administrative admission must not be replaced by a global Temporal prohibition.

The exact source/native path now has five same-final-body public-schedule failing-before/passing-after controls and an exact tuple regression, with complete146 AI target passing together. See the preserved handoff and imports for every source/raw/receipt hash, failed fixture/after attempt, exact prefix and immediate restoration. An AFTER02 real SellBuilding failure is not counted passed because the earlier Deploy stopped rejecting. The final exact tuple's reported15139 schedules are below the original72000 cap; this is not a guarantee of all756 other required outcomes. The source correction neither retires actors nor forces winners, raises limits, changes balance numbers, changes assertion meanings or fabricates a native outcome. All141AI/8M6 original bodies and139 earlier AI identities remain.
